summary: The user accidentally sent 2000 USDT through Arbitrum to a Bybit EU deposit address intended for a different supported asset structure. Bybit EU did not credit the deposit and the user reported that support declined manual recovery.
user_mistake: sent USDT through an unsupported deposit route for the receiving exchange account
prevention: Confirm the receiving exchange supports the selected asset and network combination before sending / Match the token and deposit network shown on the exchange deposit screen
